text_markup: If an instruction to end the run resolves while there is neither a run nor an encounter in progress, that effect does nothing.
text_plain: If an instruction to end the run resolves while there is neither a run nor an encounter in progress, that effect does nothing.

examples.text_markup: The Corp plays {card:Unleash} and resolves the last subroutine on {card:Lycian Multi-Munition}. The Corp will gain 1[c], but there is no further effect.
examples.text_plain: The Corp plays Unleash and resolves the last subroutine on Lycian Multi-Munition. The Corp will gain 1{c}, but there is no further effect.
